findings.issue: Popup focus loss during updates or noninteractive clicks can prevent keyboard recovery and Escape dismissal.
findings.disposition: Fixed with owned-focus recovery and open-only Escape handling; retains tester verification, independent behavior/architecture discoveries and the parent-supplied heading trigger.

findings.issue: The editor could use above-anchor space for its height while opening below and overflow the viewport.
findings.disposition: Fixed before formal review after parent inspection: chosen-side height caps, viewport clamps and offscreen dismissal; numeric placement tests verify the boundary.
